Position: Software Developer (Backend, Python/Java)
Employer: Lanternway Software
Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates

About us:
Lanternway Software develops route-planning and fleet-management software for logistics companies. Our team of 70 people works from our office in Dubai.

Your tasks:
- Design, develop and maintain backend services for our route-planning platform
- Write clean, tested code and take part in code reviews
- Work closely with product owners and frontend developers in an agile team
- Operate and monitor services in our cloud environment

Your profile:
- Degree in computer science, information systems or a comparable field
- At least 3 years of professional experience in backend development with Python or Java
- Solid knowledge of SQL databases, REST APIs and Git
- Experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines is an advantage
- Fluent English (C1 or higher)

What we offer:
- Permanent full-time contract (40 hours per week)
- Hybrid working with two office days per week in Dubai
- 30 days of annual leave and an annual training budget

Position: Sales Associate (Consumer Electronics Store)
Employer: Kestrelpoint Electronics
Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates

About us:
Kestrelpoint Electronics runs a consumer electronics store with 40 employees in a shopping centre in Dubai, selling computers, phones and household appliances.

Your tasks:
- Advise customers on the shop floor and help them choose suitable products
- Process sales, returns and payments at the checkout
- Replenish shelves and keep product displays tidy
- Take part in stock counts and in-store promotions

Your profile:
- Diploma in retail, sales or business
- At least 2 years of experience in retail sales
- Experience with cash register systems and card payments
- Friendly, confident manner with customers
- Willingness to work weekend and evening shifts
- Fluent English (C1 or higher)

What we offer:
- Permanent full-time contract with a monthly sales bonus
- Staff discount on all products
- 28 days of annual leave

Position: Warehouse Associate (Picking and Goods Receipt)
Employer: Bluequay Logistics
Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates

About us:
Bluequay Logistics provides contract logistics for online retailers and industrial suppliers from its distribution centre on the outskirts of Dubai.

Your tasks:
- Pick and pack customer orders using handheld scanners
- Check and record incoming goods
- Load and unload trucks using forklifts
- Take part in inventory counts

Your profile:
- Diploma in logistics or warehouse operations
- At least 2 years of experience in a warehouse
- Valid forklift operator certificate
- Experience with handheld scanners and a warehouse management system (e.g. SAP EWM)
- Willingness to work in early and late shifts
- Fluent English (C1 or higher)

What we offer:
- Permanent full-time contract with shift allowances
- Paid further training (e.g. dangerous goods, reach trucks)
- 28 days of annual leave

Position: Financial Accountant (General Ledger and Closing)
Employer: Corbelstone Building Services
Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates

About us:
Corbelstone Building Services plans and installs air-conditioning, ventilation and electrical systems for commercial buildings. The group has 600 employees and four subsidiaries and is managed from Dubai.

Your tasks:
- Post business transactions in the general ledger
- Prepare monthly and annual financial statements under IFRS
- Prepare tax returns and reconcile balance sheet accounts
- Support the annual audit and the group reporting

Your profile:
- Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance or business administration with a focus on accounting
- At least 3 years of professional experience in financial accounting
- Sound knowledge of IFRS; experience with group consolidation is an advantage
- Experience with month-end and year-end closing and tax returns
- Very good knowledge of SAP FI and MS Excel
- Fluent English (C1 or higher)

What we offer:
- Permanent full-time contract with flexible working hours
- Up to two days of remote work per week
- 30 days of annual leave and private health insurance

Position: Management Consultant (Operations and Process Excellence)
Employer: Halyard Operations Advisory
Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates

About us:
Halyard Operations Advisory advises industrial and manufacturing companies on operations, procurement and supply chain topics. Our team of 45 consultants works from Dubai.

Your tasks:
- Analyse client processes and develop improvement programmes
- Lead project workstreams and coordinate client teams
- Prepare and present results to client management
- Contribute to proposals and the development of our service offering

Your profile:
- University degree in business administration, industrial engineering, economics or a comparable field
- At least 3 years of experience in management consulting or in an operations role in industry
- Experience in leading project workstreams and presenting to senior management
- Strong analytical skills (Excel, PowerPoint; SQL or Power BI is an advantage)
- Willingness to travel to client sites up to three days per week
- Fluent English (C1 or higher)

What we offer:
- Permanent full-time contract with a performance-related bonus
- Structured training programme and mentoring
- 30 days of annual leave

Position: Administrative Assistant (Office and Team Assistance)
Employer: Cobaltgate Property Management
Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates

About us:
Cobaltgate Property Management manages residential and commercial properties in and around Dubai. Our office team of 25 supports the property managers.

Your tasks:
- Organise appointments, meetings and business travel for the management team
- Prepare correspondence, presentations and meeting minutes
- Maintain the document management system and pre-check incoming invoices
- Act as first point of contact for tenants and service providers

Your profile:
- Diploma in office administration, business administration or a comparable field
- At least 2 years of experience in office administration or team assistance
- Very good knowledge of MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel); experience with a document management system is an advantage
- Structured and independent way of working and discretion with confidential information
- Fluent English (C1 or higher)

What we offer:
- Permanent full-time or part-time contract (30 to 40 hours per week)
- Flexible working hours
- 30 days of annual leave
